'''Melanah Sal Graeff''' was a [[human]] [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] development executive who held the title of [[Viceprex]]. She regularly visited the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] to check on her company's interests there and in [[13 BBY]] was in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] when it was locked down due to the criminal [[Han Solo]] bribing his way through the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] security check point.

==Biography==
Melanah Sal Graeff was a [[human]] who worked as a development executive [[Viceprex]] for [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. She routinely traveled to the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] to inspect her company's factories and speak with government representatives regarding reducing export taxes.<ref name="Solo Guide" />

In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' which take place on [[Corellia]] to [[13 BBY]].</ref> Sal Graeff was present in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] on Corellia when the [[spaceport]] was locked down due to the criminal [[Han Solo]] managing to bribe his way through the security checkpoint. She had already passed through the security check point prior to the lock down but travelers were prevented from moving further into the spaceport while a search was conducted. The Viceprex passed by Han as he desperately sought somewhere to hide from the Imperials looking for him.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Melanah Sal Graeff had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, dark skin and black [[hair]] with white highlights.<ref name="Solo Guide" />

==Equipment==
While in the spaceport, Sal Graeff wore a black [[Clothing|uniform]] and [[belt]] with a black [[breath mask]] with an in-built [[comlink]].<ref name="Solo Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Melanah Sal Graeff first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified by the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Solo Guide" />
